g.desc: Panel (a) contains two input blocks on the left, horizontal arrows into a rounded VLA Model block, one arrow to an optimal driving scene icon on the right, and a two-line caption below.
g.text: (a) Traditional VLA directly maps multimodal inputs to driving

g.desc: Panel (b) repeats the two inputs and VLA block, adds a dashed CoT module inside the model, routes one output arrow to an optimal driving icon and a second arrow to a QA/Explanation box, then gives a two-line caption.
g.text: (b) Traditional VLA using CoT to generate only textual

g.desc: Panel (c) contains language and multi-view inputs feeding a tall VLA model. The model includes a red ToT-E module near the top and a green V-CoT module near the bottom. The upper output branches to four candidate driving scenes labelled Comfort, Safety, Progress, and Optimal, with a Selection arrow from Progress to Optimal. The lower output goes to a Next scene Generation icon, and a closed-loop line returns from that icon to the multi-view input.
